statline_scorecard.surface: Ink-dark scorecard with team-colored split header
statline_scorecard.avoid: Do not wrap every row in identical tiles; preserve the mirrored head-to-head structure.

chart_comparison.avoid: Do not use scorecard panels or decorative bars without an axis.

chart_timeline.avoid: Do not flatten a sequence into unordered comparison bars.

source_card.surface: Ink dossier with a clipped warm-paper citation insert
source_card.avoid: Do not style a citation like a data chart or imply a source supports claims beyond the cited statement.
